rationale: The Court is most likely to reverse narrowly on APA § 704 finality, holding that the Air Force’s permit-renewal application is not final agency action because any binding legal consequences flow only from Guam EPA’s intervening discretionary permit decision (Bennett/Franklin/Dalton), avoiding NEPA/RCRA displacement merits. A lone Sotomayor dissent is likely to stress NEPA anti-evasion and the application’s practical commitment effects, while any concurrences would mainly underscore the limited jurisdictional holding and reserve NEPA questions for review of a truly operative final action.
